text: Episode 1 analysis: rule-v1-stale0-delta-gte4 established with rule_text "select stale_projection_count == 0 and verification_delta >= 4". Successor procedure proc-threshold-plus-two-on-retired-hash deposited: when rule source retired for hash drift, keep stale_projection_count == 0 and increase verification_delta threshold by 2.

Episode 2 analysis: invalidator.json retires rule-v1-stale0-delta-gte4 for hash drift. Instructs to apply deposited successor-update procedure. Does not restate threshold. Applying procedure: old threshold 4 + 2 = 6. Successor rule: stale_projection_count == 0 and verification_delta >= 6.
Option evaluation under successor rule (stale==0, delta>=6): X(0,4) fails delta<6; Y(0,6) passes; Z(1,8) fails stale!=0. Decision: Y.
